name: Hanasaku Otome no Tame no Kiyuukyoku
original_name: 花咲くオトメのための嬉遊曲
source:
Baseball bus crashes on the way home. Many people die, and main character loses his feet. His lover is in the woman baseball team and currently recruits members for a new team. Protagonist gets invited to become this team's coach.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
棒球队乘坐的大巴在返程途中发生车祸，许多人遇难，主人公也失去了双脚。他的恋人是女子棒球队的一员，目前正在为一支新球队招募队员。主人公受邀担任这支球队的教练。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
